FX-SHAUTO-001.says: A file written before D-564, without the three settings, at Shadow/Highlight's starting settings: the sliders' lift, as D-400 drew it.

FX-SHAUTO-002.says: The three written at their starting values, off, 0 and off: the same as FX-SHAUTO-001.

FX-SHAUTO-003.says: Auto Amounts on: frame 0, the light warm scene, lifted a little by its own lightness; frame 4, the darker cold scene, lifted more.

FX-SHAUTO-004.says: Auto Amounts on with the sliders at 90 and 90: the sliders are not used, so the same as FX-SHAUTO-003.

FX-SHAUTO-005.says: Auto Amounts on, midtone contrast 40 and both clips 5: the auto lift, then D-563's steps on the frame's own lightness.

FX-SHAUTO-006.says: Temporal Smoothing 0.1 and Scene Detect on with Auto Amounts off: they do nothing without it, so the same as FX-SHAUTO-001.

FX-SHAUTO-007.says: Auto Amounts on, Temporal Smoothing 0.1 seconds, two frames each side: frame 0 judged by frames 0 to 2 (the two before are outside the layer); frame 3 by 1 to 5, across the cut, so lifted more than by itself; frame 7 by 5 to 7.

FX-SHAUTO-008.says: FX-SHAUTO-007 with Scene Detect: frame 3 judged by 1 to 3 only and frame 4 by 4 to 6 only, each side of the cut.

FX-SHAUTO-009.says: Auto Amounts on, on an adjustment layer above the holder: the frame beneath is the drawing, so the same as FX-SHAUTO-003.

FX-SHAUTO-010.says: Auto Amounts on with Temporal Smoothing 0.1 on an adjustment layer: the frames beneath at other times are not to hand, so each frame is judged by itself, as FX-SHAUTO-003, with a warning each frame.

FX-SHAUTO-011.says: Auto Amounts written "yes". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SHAUTO-012.says: Scene Detect written "maybe". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SHAUTO-013.says: Temporal Smoothing 11 seconds, above 10. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SHAUTO-014.says: Temporal Smoothing -1 seconds, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
